capabilities: Organize headings as a draggable mind map
Write and edit chapter paragraphs in place
Export a typeset PDF with footnotes, tables, figures and formulas
Style pages, fonts, callouts and charts
extras: Desktop-only; version 0.32+ needs Obsidian 1.13+. No internet, telemetry, account or payment. Writes hidden %% comments into notes that other Markdown tools (Pandoc, GitHub) show as text. Fonts and profiles stay in the vault after uninstall.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan long documents visually or export them as typeset PDFs with footnotes, figures, tables and formulas.

relations.evidence: is printed thanks to the Excalidraw plugin, which must be installed and turned on
written by hand or with the Callout Manager plugin

summary: Mind-map heading editor and long-document composer that typesets an Obsidian note into a TeX-quality PDF or self-contained HTML, no LaTeX needed.
